description.value: Mecca Halal Meats & Grocery is a halal-certified meat and grocery shop on King George Boulevard serving the South Surrey/Delta area. It offers a specialty selection of halal meats alongside general grocery staples, making it a useful resupply stop for cyclists seeking halal options. The shop was recently verified in OSM as of late May 2026.
